text: User wants the latency on the data pipeline cut from 8h to 1h.
Asking myself: where does most of the 8h actually live?
94% of every run is the same single transform. Worth zooming in.
Each row triggers a synchronous lookup. ~14M rows. That's the bottleneck.
Broadcast keeps memory under the executor limit. Looks safe.
Sample finishes in 22s vs 14m baseline. Extrapolating ~50min for full run.
